form:FormGroup.label: Colour
form:FormGroup.helpText: The template's swatch in the panel and the trace. Auto takes the palette by position.

form:FormGroup.label: Mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: The mode this template is dispatched in: pick one, or type a new one. Blank is the root. Order within a mode is dispatch priority; rename and remove modes with the panel's Modes button.

form:FormGroup.label: Consume
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether a match consumes its bytes, so the next template starts after it.

form:FormGroup.label: Params
form:FormGroup.helpText: Parameters a call-template or apply-templates can pass, one per line as name, or name = default.

form:FormGroup.label: Encoding
form:FormGroup.helpText: This template's encoding where it differs from the project's; blank inherits.

form:FormGroup.label: Ignore errors
form:FormGroup.helpText: Errors raised while this template runs are reported and do not stop the run.
